name: Medication Reconciliation
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/med_rec.json with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original is a United States Meaningful Use reporting module (ONC medication reconciliation target): every patient got the condition Medication review due at each wellness encounter (in 100% of patients, also newborns) and a medication reconciliation procedure in 45% of wellness encounters. Nothing else reads it.
